mapper.select: SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드*/ count(*) FROM AYA300 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(조회)*/ AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목명*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일시*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS NAME FROM AYA300 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N'
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%'
AND INDEX_SN LIKE #{INDEX_SN} || '%'
AND (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) LIKE '%' || #{NAME} || '%'
OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(상세) - 응용2팀 지원 _ 정원제 */ AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEX_SN /* 일련번호 */ , BB.DTL_INFO_MNG_NO AS DTL_INFO_MNG_NO /* 상세정보관리번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CRT_YMD /* 작성일자 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자 아이디 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(DD.FLNM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM /* 작성자 이름 */ , BB.ATFINO AS ATFINO /* 첨부파일번호 */ FROM AYA300 AS AA , AYA310 AS BB , SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = BB.INDEX_SN AND CC.USER_ID = AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AND DD.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYA300_SQ01.CURRVAL AS INDEX_SN FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AYA300 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(등록)*/ INDEX_SN /* 게시글제목명 */ , BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글제목명 */ , DEL_YN /* 삭제여부 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ ) VALUES( AYA300_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} , 'N' , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO AYA310 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(등록)*/ DTL_INFO_MNG_NO /*상세정보관리번호*/ , INDEX_SN /*색인일련번호*/ , ATFINO /*첨부파일*/ , THMBN_YN /*섬네일여부*/ , WRTR_ID /*작성자아이디*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ ) VALUES( AYA310_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{INDEX_SN} , #{ATFINO} , 'N' , #{loginId} , 'N' , #{loginId} , SYSDATE , #{loginId} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE AYA300 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(수정)*/ BBSCTT_TTL_NM = #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} /* 게시글제목 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN} /*게시글고유번호*/

UPDATE AYA310 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(수정)*/
ATFINO = #{ATFINO} /* 첨부파일번호 */
WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN} /*게시글고유번호*/

UPDATE AYA300 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.etcntabrd.mapper.BbsMomtListMapper : 자녀맘터치업로드(삭제)*/ DEL_YN = 'Y' /*삭제여부*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN__origin} /*게시글고유번호*/
